_template: Style 1 / objection-answers (about 36 s). Outcome first, then three objections, each a real question answered by a different element, then the contrast and the CTA.
_slots: voice.phrases[].t: rewrite every sentence for the new topic (one idea each; phrases ending in ? get the rising question tone automatically)
slides[].hl: the two headline lines for each slide, shorter than the sentence; wrap the one idea word in *stars* (two words = *a* *b*)
slides[].eye: the small label above the headline (Objection 1 of 3, The answer, ...)
slides[].props: element wording (names, messages, times). Keep 'Example' on screen. Defaults are the DUXIO cold calling reel
slides[].x: swap the element if another fits better (kit/ELEMENTS.md). Keep the cue count of the element in xw
voice.phrases[].cap: only where the on screen digits differ from the spoken words

phrases.t: The money is with the people who already asked.
Most go quiet while you are busy coaching.
AI answers every one in under sixty seconds, in your voice.
phrases.cap: AI answers every one in under 60 seconds, in your voice.

phrases.t: Three short questions sort out the serious buyers.
Reminders make sure they actually show up.
Does it sound like a robot?
No. It writes in your voice, and you approve every message.
Can't I just follow up myself?
You can. Not at two in the morning, for twenty one days.
phrases.cap: You can. Not at 2 AM, for 21 days.

phrases.t: What if they are not ready?
They get pointed to your content. Quiet ones get a check in every month.
More paying clients. Calls worth taking.
